entries.title: Freeze Product Contract And Retained Invariants

requirements.notes: Every public command and output mode remains a versioned-contract requirement.
Every retained v2 invariant must keep one owner issue and proof lane.
Exact review, GitHub truth, topology ownership, atomic state, and cleanup boundaries cannot be weakened by later v3 construction.
Unknown or intentionally changed v2 behavior stays explicit and reviewed.
Importer retention remains governed by v2-origin terminal state and rollback-window expiry.
Output filtering and templating stay in-process and cannot shell out.
Reviewer independence remains structurally checked where identity is bindable.
Closing and non-closing publication remain disjoint typed modes; PartOf cannot close a parent.
Every mutable authoritative field keeps exactly one matrix owner and typed operation path.
Command help, authorization, doctor findings, and tests remain mechanically checked against the capability matrix.
State-size warning/block behavior and audit preservation remain retained invariants.
The largest v2 bundle measurement and locked recomputation gate remain predecessor requirements.
If state-size constraints are impractical, v3 must stop for architecture review rather than weaken the factor.
The V3-16 review/recover/card-family canary sizing proof remains represented.
The frozen supported jq subset and unsupported-syntax typed error remain retained.
The retained official CLI source baseline lane remains a start gate for later construction.

entries.notes: Retained as source-grounded acceptance requirements, not compressed issue-level buckets. Later v3 issues implement only through declared ownership.

entries.title: Prove The Rust Construction Slice

requirements.notes: The one-binary/one-library four-layer construction shape remains retained.
Parsing must not initialize repository, credentials, network, or child task state.
Fake adapters retain deterministic unexpected-operation rejection.
Every required GitHub operation remains classified, with raw-request count triggering dependency re-evaluation.
The exact-review, typed-recovery, field-correction, projection, audit, and fresh-review journey remains retained.
Measurements must satisfy thresholds or trigger architecture revision before V3-03.
V3-02 recommendation alone cannot satisfy the later V3-08 Decision 11 dependency gate.

entries.notes: Retained as measured construction evidence and constraint input, not as operational authority.

entries.title: Approve platform commit matrix and Windows posture

requirements.notes: Every supported platform keeps a measured commit primitive and durability contract requirement.
Windows mutation remains equivalently proven or explicitly fail-closed read-only.
Operator approval must cite exact V3-02 evidence and cannot be inferred from recommendation text.
V3-08 remains blocked until the Decision 11 issue is terminal.

entries.notes: Retained as the operator-approved durability and rollback boundary before later transaction storage work.
